description: EGRESS step 1: Request a 30-second use-token for a stored secret. Use the ref code if you have one (preferred), or name + context. The token is a single-use nonce — not the secret itself. You must redeem it within 30 seconds via demipass_execute.

action.description: Action type: http_header, ssh_exec, http_body, document

name.description: Secret name (use ref instead when possible)

owner_did.description: Owner DID (only needed if using name without ref for delegated secrets)

ref.description: Routed reference code (e.g. DP-API-openrout-7f3a9c1e). Preferred — auto-resolves owner, delegation, context, action.

target_host.description: Target host for SSH exec actions

target_url.description: Target URL for HTTP header/body and database actions

name: demipass_get_token
